findings.title: Reload-audit exception can save historical parameters with the final optimizer as an interrupted 500-update checkpoint
findings.trigger: An exception after model.load_cnn has loaded an earlier checkpoint during the post-training reload loop, before the loop restores the final model.
findings.mechanism: The model changes but optimizer remains at 500 updates and completed remains 500. The generic exception handler serializes all three together without checking that their checkpoint identities agree.
findings.impact: interrupted.pt can contain inconsistent model/Adam/update provenance and must not be used for recovery or reported as a valid 500-update model.
findings.recommendation: Separate the read-only reload audit from the mutable training model, or do not serialize a new interrupted checkpoint after entering audit. A recovery save requires model and optimizer from the same verified checkpoint and its actual update.
findings.current_mitigation: Do not hot-edit the running source. If reload audit fails, mark interrupted output INVALID and non-resumable. Preserve the start source_snapshot; apply a separately disclosed future failure-path fix after normal completion.

non_finding_delivery_requirements.observation: The runner records but does not explicitly recheck the full manifest/validation-ID hash at startup; inherited cache.load validates identities but does not rehash all label/cache file bytes per load.
non_finding_delivery_requirements.current_evidence: An independent standard-library-only audit rehashed every file in the actual 500-draw plus 776-validation input set against both current declarations and the prior frozen input receipt.
non_finding_delivery_requirements.future_hardening: Add explicit startup checks in a later source version; do not claim the current runner already performed them.

non_finding_delivery_requirements.observation: The registered ranking differs from the reviewer's earlier main-validation-loss suggestion and has not yet been executed by train/evaluate/protocol.
non_finding_delivery_requirements.authoritative_rule: Filter by old eligible and all new development screens; minimize main weak L2, then normal RMSE, then earlier checkpoint.
non_finding_delivery_requirements.required_before_final_test: Create and freeze one selected checkpoint using the registered rule after all registered comparisons; retain the complete candidate ranking and all gate results.

static_conformance.claim_limit: Static conformance and disk integrity are not independent reruns or confirmation that the active training has finished.

independent_input_audit.timing: Concurrent independent current-disk integrity audit; not a retrospective runner preflight claim.
